stances_toward.note: Part of the Realm with self-government since 2009; Copenhagen keeps foreign and defence policy and pays the block grant, but the Self-Government Act (section 21) gives the people of Greenland the right to decide on independence, subject to a referendum and Folketing consent. Nuuk's government (Nielsen, Demokraatit, since March 2025) opposes joining the US but is also a negotiating party: the Danish line is that Greenland's red line is Denmark's. Own territory, but not a territory Denmark can dispose of alone. Bond - kin: the Realm, with a colonial history that the 2025-26 crisis has reopened.
